**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**
Code/documentation coverage tracking has been enabled and can be see from https://docs.zephyrproject.org/api-coverage/latest/. 

LE Audio (https://docs.zephyrproject.org/api-coverage/latest/zephyr/bluetooth/audio/index.html) has been good coverage for most parts, but there's no reason why we wouldn't have 100% coverage in our documentation. 

**Describe the solution you'd like**
Add missing doxygen documentation for all functions, enum, defines, etc. so that we can report 100% coverage. 

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
N/A

**Additional context**
Ideally we'd be able to enable a check to ensure that we keep it at 100% afterwards.
